description: Search the Moneda knowledge base (FAQ) for answers to questions about Moneda's features, fees, security, accounts, earnings, deposits, withdrawals, legal info, and more. Use this whenever a user asks about how Moneda works.

category.description: Optional category slug to narrow results (e.g. 'fees', 'security-and-privacy', 'earnings-account'). Use the moneda://knowledge resource to see available slugs.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5, max: 20)

query.description: Search term or question to look up in the knowledge base (e.g. 'fees', 'security', 'how to deposit')

name: search_knowledge
